ammo.name: 9 × 18 mm rounds
ammo.description: Loose rounds. Fill a compatible PM magazine before loading.

magazine.name: PM 8-round magazine
magazine.description: Individual magazine; loose rounds are not loaded automatically.

gun.name: PM service pistol
gun.description: Semi-automatic sidearm. Manual magazine, chamber and safety.

knife.name: Field knife
knife.description: Slash up close, or aim and throw. Thrown knives can be recovered.

torch.name: Handheld torch
torch.description: Occupies your hand instead of the pistol. Requires battery charge.

battery.name: Torch battery
battery.description: Restores 45% torch charge. Keep a spare for the return journey.

probes.name: Steel probes
probes.description: Throw into an anomaly before approaching its artefact.

cloth.name: Cleaning cloth
cloth.description: Useful workshop salvage. Weapon cleaning is paid at the station.

oil.name: Machine oil
oil.description: Trade to the quartermaster. Cleaning station supplies are included in its fee.

junk.name: Damp notebook
junk.description: Unreadable notes, still worth something to the quartermaster.

wire.name: Copper wire
wire.description: Recoverable copper. Sell at the refuge.

film.name: Film canister
film.description: Old survey film. A valuable curiosity.

screws.name: Tin of screws
screws.description: Ordinary hardware. Useful only as trade salvage.

mug.name: Enamel mug
mug.description: A chipped cup. Someone at the station will buy it.

lighter.name: Old lighter
lighter.description: Small trade item, not a torch substitute.

cap.name: Wool cap
cap.description: Head slot. Warm but not protective.

helmet.name: Steel helmet
helmet.description: Head slot. Modest protection at a weight cost.

trainers.name: Worn trainers
trainers.description: Footwear slot. Quieter walking than heavy boots.

boots.name: Leather boots
boots.description: Footwear slot. More protection, louder steps.

shard.name: Amber echo
shard.description: An anomaly artefact. Trade it or keep it for a contract.

bead.name: Cold bead
bead.description: A rare artefact. Crush for 35 health or sell it.

recorder.name: Survey recorder
recorder.description: Guaranteed contract item. Cannot be sold or discarded.

ledger.name: Coastguard tide ledger
ledger.description: Guaranteed contract item. Cannot be sold or discarded.

postbag.name: Sealed village postbag
postbag.description: Guaranteed contract item. Cannot be sold or discarded.

relay.name: Rail signal relay
relay.description: Guaranteed contract item. Cannot be sold or discarded.

fuse.name: Pier power fuse
fuse.description: Guaranteed contract item. Cannot be sold or discarded.

case.name: Lost medical case
case.description: Guaranteed contract item. Cannot be sold or discarded.

sample.name: Hollow resonance sample
sample.description: Guaranteed contract item. Cannot be sold or discarded.

carbine.name: M12 patrol carbine
carbine.description: A more accurate 9 × 18 mm patrol carbine. Takes M12 twelve-round magazines.

carbine_mag.name: M12 12-round magazine
carbine_mag.description: Only fits the patrol carbine. Uses your loose 9 × 18 mm rounds.

detector.name: Artefact detector
detector.description: Use Scan in marked anomaly fields to reveal artefacts.

tuna.name: Tinned tuna
tuna.description: Compact food. Demand at the trader can make it unusually valuable.

stormglass.name: Storm glass
stormglass.description: A scan-revealed artefact from the humming quarry.

knot.name: Magnetic knot
knot.description: An unstable, high-value find from the dead marsh.

poster_signal.name: The Last Signal print
poster_signal.description: An original fictional film poster for your room.

poster_orbit.name: Orbit Zero print
poster_orbit.description: An original fictional film poster for your room.

poster_return.name: Return to the Zone print
poster_return.description: An original fictional film poster for your room.

rug.name: Ochre bedside rug
rug.description: A woven rug for your quarters.

lamp_blue.name: Blue desk-lamp shade
lamp_blue.description: An alternate cool lamp colour for your room.

cave_log.name: Cave survey film
cave_log.description: Protected contract item. Return it to the relay radio.

bunker_key.name: Evacuation keycard
bunker_key.description: Protected contract item. Return it to the relay radio.

north_map.name: Northern weather log
north_map.description: Protected contract item. Return it to the relay radio.

rifle.name: R7 patrol rifle
rifle.description: A five-round 7.62 mm rifle found in the fortified armoury.

rifle_mag.name: R7 five-round magazine
rifle_mag.description: Only fits the R7. Uses 7.62 mm rifle rounds.

signal_torch.name: Three-colour signal torch
signal_torch.description: Cycles white, red and green beams, then off.

receiver.name: Tower signal receiver
receiver.description: A sealed receiver recovered from the northern transmission tower.

orders.name: Garrison orders
orders.description: A sealed command envelope from the military compound.

sewer_map.name: Drainage maintenance plan
sewer_map.description: A marked tunnel plan; return it to the quartermaster.

beacon_core.name: Encrypted beacon core
beacon_core.description: The final signal source, secured in the north armoury.

missions.title: First signal
missions.description: Recover the recorder from the drawers in Survey hut 03. Bring it to Relay 07.

missions.title: The tide ledger
missions.description: The coastguard logged a signal before the evacuation. Search the office drawers on the shore.

missions.title: Dead letters
missions.description: A sealed postbag remains in the Postmaster’s house. Search its wall cupboard in the village.

missions.title: The missing relay
missions.description: Recover the rail signal relay from the tool cupboard in the old signal box.

missions.title: After closing
missions.description: Find the power fuse in the amusement hall tool cupboard. The pier is safe to walk on, the sea is not.

missions.title: Saltwater medicine
missions.description: Recover the medical case from the pier café medicine cabinet.

missions.title: What the hollow kept
missions.description: Retrieve the resonance sample from the supply crate in Survey cabin 06, beyond the north hollow.

missions.title: Beneath the roots
missions.description: Descend into Hollowstone cave and recover the survey film.

missions.title: The forgotten evacuation
missions.description: Enter the substation storage shelter and recover the keycard.

missions.title: Weather station silence
missions.description: Climb the north signal house stairs and retrieve the weather log.

missions.title: Dead air at the tower
missions.description: Cross the eastern river and reach the northern transmission mast. Recover its receiver from the cabin’s upstairs chest. Return it to the relay radio.

missions.title: A route below the wire
missions.description: Mikhail needs the drainage plan from the maintenance case. The riverside tunnel connects to the military compound. Return the plan to the quartermaster.

missions.title: Orders from no one
missions.description: The military compound is occupied by armed echoes. Recover the command envelope. A breach in the rear wall and the drainage tunnels offer alternatives to the main gate.

missions.title: The last transmission
missions.description: Find the encrypted beacon core in the armoury chest and return to Relay 07. Expect concentrated armed resistance.

missions.title: Something worth cooking
missions.description: Nadia needs three tins of tuna for the canteen. Search kitchens and cupboards, then bring the tins back to her.
